description: Rendering every known route to HTML at build time and serving the files from a CDN. Nothing runs per request.
The list of dynamic route values to prebuild: `generateStaticParams` in the Next.js App Router, `getStaticPaths` in the Pages Router.
Data loaded during the build for each page (`getStaticProps` in the Pages Router, `fetch` in a Server Component at build). Frozen until the next build.
Paths not generated at build time return 404 instead of being rendered on demand.
Renders HTML without hydration markers: ideal for pages that ship no JavaScript.
Static HTML shows the data as it was at build time; updates require a rebuild (or ISR).
